source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Update — How We're Building the Team
Due to the overwhelming response to this role — and the number of people who kept coming back to show their interest — we've decided to change our selection process.
Instead of a trial clip, we're moving to a pre-call screening form. This lets us build the strongest possible crew from the start — people who are the right fit, not just the right editors.
Here's what happens next:
Fill out the form below. We review every submission. If you pass, you're in — straight onto the team with full guidelines, account access, and your payment tracker set up so you can start earning immediately.
No trial. No waiting around. Just the form, a decision, and we move.
<https://app.notion.com/p/36c77021d09c80558aeef48e0d509067?pvs=106>

This spot is limited. We're not building a big crowd — we're building a tight, high-output crew. If you've been showing up and staying consistent in your replies, this is your moment.
Fill it out now.
